text:
appa-pm: Heads-up 
Proposing a per-route fallback policy + minimal telemetry contract. Aim: predictable behavior per product route (chat vs embeddings) and clear VIP exemptions. Sketch below.

jules-eng: +1. We need fallback tiers per route. Suggest: tier0 (no fallback), tier1 (throttle/context trim), tier2 (model downgrade), tier3 (cross-region reroute).

appa-pm: Exactly. We'll map routes to tiers in a config and allow per-tenant overrides. Also need a simple telemetry contract: p95, error-rate, and quality-sample-rate per route.

kira-sre: Safety rules: trigger fallback when route_p95 > baseline + 150ms AND route_util > 80% for 2m. Rollback if error_rate > 1% for 3m. Capture 50 sample requests pre/post fallback for quality checks.

sam-ops: Flag knobs draft:
```
route_fallback_mode: off|monitor|tier1|tier2|tier3
route_fallback_pct: 0-100
route_exempt_tenants: [tenant_ids]
route_cooldown_s: 600
max_route_fallbacks_per_hour: 4
```
Keep these per-route and per-region.

nora-sales: Customer ask: some enterprise customers need route-level non-fallback guarantees during business hours. We'll support `route_exempt_tenants` and a reserved-pool routing option; pricing conversation pending.

jules-eng: Canary plan: shadow detection -> 1% route traffic (10m) -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (1h). Always compare outputs via blind evaluation for semantic drift. Stop if quality delta breaches threshold.

kira-sre: Add circuit-breaker: token-bucket limiter to avoid > X fallbacks/sec. Also include a manual panic toggle. We'll add simulation tests in canary pipeline.

appa-pm: Launch criteria (MVP): docs + API to set `route_exempt_tenants`, runbook + panic play, dashboards for p95/p99/error-rate/fallbacks, zero customer-visible regressions in canary window.

nora-sales: I'll draft customer comms and an FAQ mapping tiers to user impact.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `rollout/route-fallbacks/v1` -> canary start 2026-04-08T16:00:00Z (1% chat-route eu-west)

sam-ops: I'll own dashboard queries and runbook. Ping me if you need sample queries or alert thresholds.

appa-pm: Thanks. I'll open the PRD and tag legal/sales for reserved-pool terms. If anyone has additional must-haves, add them here and I'll fold into the ticket.
